use equivalent::{Comparable, Equivalent};
use std::cmp::Ordering;

struct Key(u32, u32);
struct Query(u32);
impl Equivalent<Key> for Query {
    fn equivalent(&self, key: &Key) -> bool { self.0 == key.0 }
}
impl Comparable<Key> for Query {
    fn compare(&self, key: &Key) -> Ordering { self.0.cmp(&key.0) }
}
fn equivalent_to<Q: ?Sized + Equivalent<K>, K: ?Sized>(query: &Q, key: &K) -> bool {
    query.equivalent(key)
}
fn compare_to<Q: ?Sized + Comparable<K>, K: ?Sized>(query: &Q, key: &K) -> Ordering {
    query.compare(key)
}
fn main() {
    let words = [String::from("alpha"), String::from("beta"), String::from("gamma")];
    let mut matches = 0u32;
    let mut less = 0u32;
    for query in ["alpha", "beta", "delta", "gamma"] {
        for key in &words {
            if equivalent_to(query, key) { matches += 1; }
            if compare_to(query, key) == Ordering::Less { less += 1; }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(matches, 3);
    assert_eq!(less, 4);
    assert!(equivalent_to(&7u32, &7u32));
    assert_eq!(compare_to(&7u32, &9u32), Ordering::Less);
    assert!(equivalent_to(&[1u32, 2][..], &[1u32, 2][..]));
    let keys = [Key(3, 30), Key(5, 50), Key(9, 90)];
    let mut found = 0;
    let mut payload = 0;
    for query in [Query(3), Query(4), Query(9)] {
        for key in &keys {
            if equivalent_to(&query, key) { found += 1; payload += key.1; }
            assert_eq!(compare_to(&query, key) == Ordering::Equal, equivalent_to(&query, key));
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(found, 2);
    assert_eq!(payload, 120);
    println!("equivalent {} {} {} {}", matches, less, found, payload);
}
